BiblicalUsage: The word names expectation, what a man waits for, and the prophets use it for hopes that fail. Isaiah says Ethiopia and Egypt were the expectation of those who fled to them for help, and they shall be afraid and ashamed, and Zechariah says the expectation of Ekron shall be ashamed when the king perishes from Gaza.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe expectation is the test of where our hope lies, because the hopes we set on men and nations will be ashamed. I hold that only the expectation set on God stands, and every other hope ends in fear.
